   "source": [
    "# Demo: Rover Response Optimization\n",
    "\n",
    "This notebook shows how variables in an fmdtools model can be optimized for resilience.\n",
    "\n",
    "```\n",
    "Copyright © 2024, United States Government, as represented by the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. All rights reserved.\n",
    "\n",
    "The “\"Fault Model Design tools - fmdtools version 2\"” software is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the \"License\"); you may not use this file except in compliance with the License. You may obtain a copy of the License at http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0. \n",
    "\n",
    "Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software distributed under the License is distributed on an \"AS IS\" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations under the License.\n",
    "```\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2024-01-08T23:03:46.457680Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2024-01-08T23:03:46.457680Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2024-01-08T23:03:48.451379Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2024-01-08T23:03:48.451379Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from fmdtools.sim.sample import SampleApproach, FaultSample, FaultDomain, ParameterDomain\n",
    "import fmdtools.analyze as an\n",
    "import fmdtools.sim.propagate as prop\n",
    "from fmdtools.sim.search import ParameterSimProblem\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import multiprocessing as mp\n",
    "import time"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Model is in defined model_main.py"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2023-09-29T21:52:33.006156Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2023-09-29T21:52:33.006156Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2023-09-29T21:52:34.005819Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2023-09-29T21:52:34.004833Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from fmdtools_examples.navigating_rover.model_main import Rover, RoverParam"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Optimization\n",
    "\n",
    "Here we define the optimization problem for the rover.\n",
    "\n",
    "We use a parallel pool, staged execution, and minimal tracking options to lower computational cost as much as possible."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "mdl = Rover(sp={'end_condition': ''}, track={'flows':{\"ground\":\"all\", \"pos\": \"all\"}})\n",
    "#rover_prob = search.ProblemInterface(\"rover_problem\", mdl, pool=mp.Pool(5), staged=True, track=track)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "time:                         array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.r.probdens:      array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.s.in_bound:      array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.phases:       array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.start_time:   array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.end_time:     array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.track_times:  array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.dt:           array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.units:        array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.end_condition: array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.use_local:    array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.with_loadings: array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.run_stochastic: array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.sp.track_pdf:    array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.c.r.probdens:    array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.ga.points.start.s.on: array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.ga.points.start.s.near: array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.ga.points.end.s.on: array(151)\n",
       "flows.ground.ga.points.end.s.near: array(151)\n",
       "flows.pos.s.x:                array(151)\n",
       "flows.pos.s.y:                array(151)\n",
       "flows.pos.s.vel:              array(151)\n",
       "flows.pos.s.ux:               array(151)\n",
       "flows.pos.s.uy:               array(151)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 4,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "mdl.h"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "RoverParam(ground=GroundParam(linetype='sine', amp=1.0, period=6.283185307179586, radius=20.0, x_start=10.0, y_end=10.0, x_min=0.0, x_max=30.0, x_res=0.1, path_buffer_on=0.2, path_buffer_poor=0.3, path_buffer_near=0.4, dest_buffer_on=1.0, dest_buffer_near=2.0), correction=ResCorrection(ub_f=10.0, lb_f=-1.0, ub_t=10.0, lb_t=0.0, ub_d=2.0, lb_d=-2.0, cor_d=0.0, cor_t=0.0, cor_f=0.0), degradation=DegParam(friction=0.0, drift=0.0), drive_modes={'mode_options': 'set'})"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "mdl.p"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Here we will be optimizing over faults in the drive system at 3 points during the drive simulation interval:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 400x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "endresults, mdlhist = prop.nominal(Rover())\n",
    "phasemap = an.phases.from_hist(mdlhist)\n",
    "fault_domain = FaultDomain(mdl)\n",
    "fault_domain.add_all_fxnclass_modes('Drive')\n",
    "fault_sample = FaultSample(fault_domain, phasemap['plan_path'])\n",
    "fault_sample.add_fault_phases('drive',  args=(3,))\n",
    "fig, ax = mdlhist.plot_trajectories(\"flows.pos.s.x\", \"flows.pos.s.y\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The variables are the correction factors int the fault management: "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "scrolled": true
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "ParameterDomain with:\n",
       " - variables: {'correction.cor_f': (0, 1), 'correction.cor_d': (-1, 1), 'correction.cor_t': (-1, 1)}\n",
       " - constants: {}\n",
       " - parameter_initializer: RoverParam"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "pd = ParameterDomain(RoverParam)\n",
    "pd.add_variables(\"correction.cor_f\", \"correction.cor_d\", \"correction.cor_t\", lims={\"correction.cor_f\":(0, 1), \n",
    "                                                                                         \"correction.cor_d\":(-1, 1),\n",
    "                                                                                         \"correction.cor_t\":(-1, 1)})\n",
    "pd"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we setup the optimization problem using `ParameterSimProblem`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We can define multiple objectives, below we will use the end distance and total_deviation from `classify`. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "class RoverProb(ParameterSimProblem):\n",
    "    def init_problem(self, **kwargs):\n",
    "        self.add_parameterdomain(pd)\n",
    "        self.add_sim(mdl, \"fault_sample\", fault_sample, **kwargs)\n",
    "        self.add_result_objective('f1', 'classify.end_dist')\n",
    "        self.add_result_objective('f2', 'classify.tot_deviation')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "RoverProb with:\n",
       "VARIABLES\n",
       " -correction.cor_f                                              nan\n",
       " -correction.cor_d                                              nan\n",
       " -correction.cor_t                                              nan\n",
       "OBJECTIVES\n",
       " -f1                                                            nan\n",
       " -f2                                                            nan"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "rover_prob = RoverProb()\n",
    "rover_prob"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Here we do some basic timing:"
   ]
  },

    "rover_prob.f1(0.6,0.5,0.5)\n",
    "t=time.time()-a\n",
    "t"
   ]

     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "RoverProb with:\n",
       "VARIABLES\n",
       " -correction.cor_f                                           0.7000\n",
       " -correction.cor_d                                           0.5000\n",
       " -correction.cor_t                                           0.5000\n",
       "OBJECTIVES\n",
       " -f1                                                       132.2823\n",
       " -f2                                                         2.5270"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 14,

    }
   ],
   "source": [

   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Rover Optimization: "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from pymoo.optimize import minimize\n",
    "from pymoo.algorithms.soo.nonconvex.pattern import PatternSearch\n",
    "from pymoo.problems.functional import FunctionalProblem\n",
    "import numpy as np"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Covert optimization problem into a pymoo problem"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from multiprocessing import Pool\n",
    "rover_prob = RoverProb(pool=Pool(4), auto_close_pool=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "n_var = len(rover_prob.variables)\n",
    "x_low = np.array([])\n",
    "x_up = np.array([])\n",
    "for bound in rover_prob.parameterdomain.variables.values():\n",
    "    x_low = np.append(x_low, bound[0])\n",
    "    x_up = np.append(x_up, bound[1])\n",
    "    \n",
    "obj = [lambda x: rover_prob.f1(*x)]\n",
    "pymoo_prob = FunctionalProblem(n_var, obj, xl = x_low, xu= x_up)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 22,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "arg={}\n",
    "pymoo_prob._evaluate([0.7,0.5,0.5],arg)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 23,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "{'F': array([132.28226465]),\n",
       " 'G': array([], dtype=float64),\n",
       " 'H': array([], dtype=float64)}"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 23,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "arg"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Run optimizaion algorithm.."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 24,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "algorithm=PatternSearch(x0=np.array([0.7,0.5,0.5])) "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 25,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "=================================================\n",
      "n_gen  |  n_eval  |     f_avg     |     f_min    \n",
      "=================================================\n",
      "     1 |        1 |  1.322823E+02 |  1.322823E+02\n",
      "     2 |        7 |  1.307473E+02 |  1.292124E+02\n",
      "     3 |       13 |  1.268410E+02 |  1.244696E+02\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from pymoo.termination import get_termination\n",
    "# early termination \n",
    "termination = get_termination(\"n_eval\", 13)\n",
    "res = minimize(pymoo_prob, algorithm, termination=termination, verbose=True)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 26,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [

     "execution_count": 26,

     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.X"
   ]

   ]
  },
